meta.dataNote: RAW historical picks included. seasons[] holds per-season sorted price vectors for resampling; rawPicks[] is every individual pick.

formatNotes: Keepers existed 2022-2025 only, at prior price + $10. Keeper prices are BELOW market and distort the curve. Exclude them (keeper=true) when resampling auction behaviour.
The kicker slot became a second flex starting 2021. Seasons 2017-2020 rostered a kicker; 2021+ did not. Deep-rank prices tested nearly identical across that change, so all nine seasons are usable.
nominationPick is the order the player was NOMINATED, not the order of price. Use it for timing effects.
Seven rows are "--empty--" placeholders with a price but no player or position; drop them from positional work.

validationTargets.note: TESTS ONLY, not modelling inputs. Derived from the same raw data; use to verify the simulator reproduces reality.
